home.title: Datadog • Senior Design Manager, Design Systems • Carl Avidano
home.description: Carl Avidano’s selected work for Datadog: accessible design-system ownership, adoption, UX leadership, and collaboration with developers.
home.panelHeading: The Senior Design Manager role combines three of my passions: leading designers, leveraging research to guide decisions, and creating inclusive design systems.
home.headline: I'm a UX manager with a background in research, design systems, and digital accessibility.
home.introduction: I welcome the chance to help shape DRUIDS by understanding where teams need support and using research to guide our priorities. I’ve managed designers and developed design systems both independently and with collaborative teams. As DRUIDS evolves for AI-assisted work, I will keep accessibility, usability, and craft at the center of what gets shipped.
home.who: I'm a UX manager, researcher, and design systems engineer. I've collaborated with government agencies, international nonprofits, educational organizations, and intergovernmental organizations.
home.what: I connect UX research with inclusive design and working code. I’ve managed and mentored designers, aligned stakeholders around a shared strategy, and built inclusive design systems.
